images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable, extreme low-angle heroic frame. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. World: Medieval sky castle, location: backstage movie studio disaster set. Event: Ancient vault opening, the patriotic shield-bearing symbol hero performs one decisive action while leaning far over a ledge, pressing an unbranded defensive shield beside an ancient paw-sized stone key as a glowing vault opens onto an impossible horizon. The role is patriotic shield-bearing symbol hero, with bright, clearly separated suit colors, no official logo. Expression: enormous open-mouth yawn. Gesture: leaning far over a ledge. Twist: the villain is a random supporting cat double agent, a distinct black tuxedo cat visibly passing the key toward the hero. Visual hook: extreme low-angle heroic frame. Outcome: the escape route opens beneath one decisive paw, revealing a bright safe stairway under the set rather than the vault treasure. Strong silhouette, shield, key, yawning face, cloud castle, and readable cause-and-consequence. Secure transparent support, low ledge, harmless practical props, correct feline anatomy and white paw contact. No cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, malformed anatomy, duplicate cats, duplicate limbs, human features, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, famous artwork, franchise design, actor likeness, readable title.
Required assigned visual details: no official logo, no exact emblem, no exact costume copy.
